verses.sloka: प्रतिप्रविष्टे लङ्कां तु कृतार्थे रावणात्मजे ।राघवं परिवार्यार्ता ररक्षुर्वानरर्षभाः ।। ६.४७.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pratipraviṣṭe laṅkāṁ tu kṛtārthe rāvaṇātmaje ।rāghavaṁ parivāryārtā rarakṣurvānararṣabhāḥ ।। 6.47.1 ।।।।

translations.english: After accomplishing the task Ravana's son entered Lanka while the bull among monkeys guarded Raghava staying around.

verses.sloka: हनुमानङ्गदो नीलः सुषेणः कुमुदो नलः ।गजो गवाक्षो गवयः शरभो गन्धमादनः ।जाम्बवानृषभः स्कन्धो रम्भः शतवलिः पृथुः ।। ६.४७.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hanumānaṅgado nīlaḥ suṣeṇaḥ kumudo nalaḥ ।gajo gavākṣo gavayaḥ śarabho gandhamādanaḥ ।jāmbavānṛṣabhaḥ skandho rambhaḥ śatavaliḥ pṛthuḥ ।। 6.47.2 ।।।।

translations.english: Having arranged the army in place, Hanuman, Angada, Nila, Kumuda, Nala, Gava, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Sanuprastha, Jambavan, Rshaba, Rambha, Satavali, Pruthu, who are always alert were holding trees and looking above, on either side and in all directions and guarded Rama. Whenever there was movement of even a blade of grass, they thought that it might be Rakshasa.
translations.hindi: जैसे इन्द्र वर्षा कर चुकते हैं, वैसे ही जब न्द्र बाणों की वर्षा कर चुका, तब वहाँ तिहि इन्द्रजीत बाण SEE श प | त विभीषण पहुँचे

verses.sloka: व्यूढानीकाश्च यत्ताश्च द्रुमानादाय सर्वतः ।वीक्षमाणा दिशः सर्वास्तिर्यगूर्ध्वं च वानराः ।तृणेष्वपि च चेष्टत्सु राक्षसा इति मेनिरे ।। ६.४७.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vyūḍhānīkāśca yattāśca drumānādāya sarvataḥ ।vīkṣamāṇā diśaḥ sarvāstiryagūrdhvaṁ ca vānarāḥ ।tṛṇeṣvapi ca ceṣṭatsu rākṣasā iti menire ।। 6.47.3 ।।।।

translations.english: Having arranged the army in place, Hanuman, Angada, Nila, Kumuda, Nala, Gava, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Sanuprastha, Jambavan, Rshaba, Rambha, Satavali, Pruthu, who are always alert were holding trees and looking above, on either side and in all directions and guarded Rama. Whenever there was movement of even a blade of grass, they thought that it might be Rakshasa.
translations.hindi: र्न St ७ 2 च्छ गील, द्विवि इ, मनद, छपेण, कुमुद ओर अङ्गद; हनुमान से साथ मिल कर, दोनों भाइयों के विषय में शोकान्बित हुए

verses.sloka: रावणश्चापि संहृष्टो विसृज्येन्द्रजितं सुतम् ।आजुहाव ततः सीतारक्षिणी राक्षसीस्तदा ।। ६.४७.४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇaścāpi saṁhṛṣṭo visṛjyendrajitaṁ sutam ।ājuhāva tataḥ sītārakṣiṇī rākṣasīstadā ।। 6.47.4 ।।।।

translations.english: Having arranged the army in place, Hanuman, Angada, Nila, Kumuda, Nala, Gava, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Sanuprastha, Jambavan, Rshaba, Rambha, Satavali, Pruthu, who are always alert were holding trees and looking above, on either side and in all directions and guarded Rama. Whenever there was movement of even a blade of grass, they thought that it might be Rakshasa.
translations.hindi: दोनों भाई निश्चेष्ट, मन्द-शवास-युक्त, रुधिर से तराबोर, बाणों से विधे, शरश्य्या पर सो रहे थे

verses.sloka: राक्षस्यस्त्रिजटा चैव शासनात् समुपस्थिताः ।। ६.४७.५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasyastrijaṭā caiva śāsanāt samupasthitāḥ ।। 6.47.5 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana was also content to send away his son Indrajith and calls for the Rakshasa woman, caretaker of Sita.
translations.hindi: ओर सर्प की तरह साँस ले रहे थे, उनके शरीर चेष्टाहीन हो रहे थे, उनका पराक्रम मन्द्‌ पड़ गया था। उनके शरीर लोहू में सने हुए थे । वे दोनों सुवणं की दो ध्वजाओं की तरह भूमि पर पड़े हुए थे

verses.sloka: ता उवाच ततो हृष्टो राक्षसी राक्षसाधिपः ।। ६.४७.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tā uvāca tato hṛṣṭo rākṣasī rākṣasādhipaḥ ।। 6.47.6 ।।।।

translations.english: The rakshasi and also Trijata came and waited there by the order. Lowly Rakshasa, Ravana, full of joy addressed rakshasi.
translations.hindi: वे दोनों वीर शय्या पर लेटे हुए, मन्द-चेश्टा-युक्त हो रहे थे। उन दोनों को वानरयूथपति घेरे हुए ये । उनके नेत्रां से आँधुओं को धोर बह रही थीं

verses.sloka: हताविन्द्रजिता ऽ ऽख्यात वैदेह्या रामलक्ष्मणौ ।पुष्पकं च समारोप्य दर्शयध्वं हतौ रणे ।। ६.४७.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hatāvindrajitā ' 'khyāta vaidehyā rāmalakṣmaṇau ।puṣpakaṁ ca samāropya darśayadhvaṁ hatau raṇe ।। 6.47.7 ।।।।

translations.english: "Rama and Lakshmana are killed by Indrajith in war. Take Vaidehi in the aerial car and show her."
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र और लक्ष्मण को शरजाल में फँसा हुआ देख, विभीषण सहित समस्त वानर व्यथित हुए

verses.sloka: यदाश्रयादवष्टब्धा नेयं मामुपतिष्ठति ।सो ऽस्या भर्त्ता सह भ्रात्रा निरस्तो रणमूर्धनि ।। ६.४७.८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadāśrayādavaṣṭabdhā neyaṁ māmupatiṣṭhati ।so 'syā bharttā saha bhrātrā nirasto raṇamūrdhani ।। 6.47.8 ।।।।

translations.english: "That husband with whose support she was proud and not yielding to me is unconscious along with his brother who have been killed," said Ravana.
translations.hindi: आकाश तथा समस्त दिशाओं की ओर देखते हुए भी, उन चानरों को माया के बल से छिपा हुआ मेघनाद युद्धत्तेत्र में कहीं भी न देख पडो

verses.sloka: निर्विशङ्का निरुद्विग्ना निरपेक्षा च मैथिली ।मामुपस्थास्यते सीता सर्वाभरणभूषिता ।। ६.४७.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nirviśaṅkā nirudvignā nirapekṣā ca maithilī ।māmupasthāsyate sītā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā ।। 6.47.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "Mythili, rid of sorrow and free from perturbation, giving up hope (of Rama) can wait upon me adorned with all kinds of jewels."

verses.sloka: अद्य कालवशं प्राप्तं रणे रामं सलक्ष्मणम् ।अवेक्ष्य विनिवृत्ताशा चान्यां गतिमपश्यती ।निरपेक्षा विशालाक्षी मामुपस्थास्यते स्वयम् ।। ६.४७.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: adya kālavaśaṁ prāptaṁ raṇe rāmaṁ salakṣmaṇam ।avekṣya vinivṛttāśā cānyāṁ gatimapaśyatī ।nirapekṣā viśālākṣī māmupasthāsyate svayam ।। 6.47.10 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana thought that the broad eyed Sita coming to conclusion in course of time that Rama has gone along with Lakshmana, rid of hope, with no other haven, will seek him on her own accord.
translations.hindi: और जाना कि, युद्ध में इसके' समान योद्धा दूसरा नहीं है। विभीषण ने देखा कि, वरदान के प्रभाव से छिपा छुआ मेघनाद तेज, यश और विक्रम से युक्त है । इन्द्रजीत अपनी करतूत से उन दोनों को पड़ा हुआ देख

verses.sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं च श्रुत्वा रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ।राक्षस्यस्तास्तथेत्युक्त्वा जग्मुर्वै यत्र पुष्पकम् ।। ६.४७.११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ ca śrutvā rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ ।rākṣasyastāstathetyuktvā jagmurvai yatra puṣpakam ।। 6.47.11 ।।।।

translations.english: The evil minded Rakshasas listening to Ravana's words went to the aerial car.

verses.sloka: ततः पुष्पकमादाय राक्षस्यो रावणाज्ञया ।अशोकवनिकास्थां तां मैथिलीं समुपानयन् ।। ६.४७.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ puṣpakamādāya rākṣasyo rāvaṇājñayā ।aśokavanikāsthāṁ tāṁ maithilīṁ samupānayan ।। 6.47.12 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter, by Ravana's order the Rakshasas went with the aerial car to Mythili in the Ashoka Garden.
translations.hindi: स्वयं परमप्रसन्न हो और अन्य राक्षसा की हषित करता हुआ उनसे कहने लगा--देखो, खरदूषण के मारने वाले, दोनों महाबली

verses.sloka: तामादाय तु राक्षस्यो भर्तृशोकपराजिताम् ।सीतामारोपयामासुर्विमानं पुष्पकं तदा ।। ६.४७.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāmādāya tu rākṣasyo bhartṛśokaparājitām ।sītāmāropayāmāsurvimānaṁ puṣpakaṁ tadā ।। 6.47.13 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the Rakshasas took the aerial car near Sita who was overcome by her husband's grief.
translations.hindi: ये दोनों भाई राम और लक्ष्मण मेरे वाणों,से मारे/गए । भले ही समस्त देवता ऋषि और देत्य मिल कर आवे, पर इनको अब कोई भी इस वाणबन्धन से छुड़ा नहीं सकता । जिनके लिए सोच विचार करते करते और शोक से विकल मेरे पिता

verses.sloka: ततः पुष्पकमारोप्य सीतां त्रिजटया सह ।जग्मुर्दर्शयितुं तस्यै राक्षस्यो रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.४७.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ puṣpakamāropya sītāṁ trijaṭayā saha ।jagmurdarśayituṁ tasyai rākṣasyo rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.47.14 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter the Rakshasas along with Trijata went to Sita and made her ascend Pushpaka to see Rama and Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: रावणो ऽकारयल्लङ्कां पताकाध्वजमालिनीम् ।प्राघोषयत हृष्टश्च लङ्कायां राक्षसेश्वरः ।राघवो लक्ष्मणश्चैव हताविन्द्रजिता रणे ।। ६.४७.१५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇo 'kārayallaṅkāṁ patākādhvajamālinīm ।prāghoṣayata hṛṣṭaśca laṅkāyāṁ rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।rāghavo lakṣmaṇaścaiva hatāvindrajitā raṇe ।। 6.47.15 ।।।।

translations.english: The Lord of Rakshasas rejoiced and went to Lanka decorated with flags and posts proclaiming that Rama and Lakshmana were killed by Indrajith in war.
translations.hindi: चार पहर रात खाट पर लेटे बिना ही विता देतेथे ऑर जिसके कारण यह सारी की सारी लङ्का वर्षांकालीन नदी को तरह विकल ही रही थी

verses.sloka: विमानेनापि सीता तु गत्वा त्रिजटया सह ।ददर्श वानराणां तु सर्वं सैन्यं निपातितम् ।। ६.४७.१६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vimānenāpi sītā tu gatvā trijaṭayā saha ।dadarśa vānarāṇāṁ tu sarvaṁ sainyaṁ nipātitam ।। 6.47.16 ।।।।

translations.english: The Lord of Rakshasas rejoiced and went to Lanka decorated with flags and posts proclaiming that Rama and Lakshmana were killed by Indrajith in war.
translations.hindi: और जो हमारी सब की जड़ नाश करने वाला और अनथे- ' कारी था; उस राम को मैंने आज सार डाला । देखो, अब राम, लक्ष्मण ओर सब वानरों का समस्त पराक्रम पैसे ही व्यथः हो. गया है, जैसे शरदूकालीन मेघ का | अपने समीप खड़े हुए सब राक्षसो से यह कह कर

verses.sloka: प्रहृष्टमनसश्चापि ददर्श पिशिताशनान् ।वानरांश्चापि दुःखार्तान् रामलक्ष्मणपार्श्वतः ।। ६.४७.१७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: prahṛṣṭamanasaścāpi dadarśa piśitāśanān ।vānarāṁścāpi duḥkhārtān rāmalakṣmaṇapārśvataḥ ।। 6.47.17 ।।।।

translations.english: Sita and Trijata flying on the Pushpaka saw all the fallen Vanara army.

verses.sloka: ततः सीता ददर्शोभौ शयानौ शरतल्पयोः ।लक्ष्मणं चापि रामं च विसञ्ज्ञौ शरपीडितौ ।। ६.४७.१८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sītā dadarśobhau śayānau śaratalpayoḥ ।lakṣmaṇaṁ cāpi rāmaṁ ca visañjñau śarapīḍitau ।। 6.47.18 ।।।।

translations.english: Sita beheld extremely happy Rakshasas, and grief stricken Vanaras, in great agony near Rama and Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: विध्वस्तकवचौ वीरौ विप्रविद्धशरासनौ ।सायकैश्छिन्नसर्वाङ्गौ शरस्तम्बमयौ क्षितौ ।। ६.४७.१९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vidhvastakavacau vīrau vipraviddhaśarāsanau ।sāyakaiśchinnasarvāṅgau śarastambamayau kṣitau ।। 6.47.19 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter Sita beheld both Rama and Lakshmana lying on the bed of arrows, unconscious, struck by arrows, with shields of darts, arrows with feathers, all limbs wounded with shattered armour, bows and reeds.

verses.sloka: तौ दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरौ तत्र वीरौ सा पुरुषर्षभौ ।शयानौ पुण्डरीकाक्षौ कुमाराविव पावकी ।। ६.४७.२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tau dṛṣṭvā bhrātarau tatra vīrau sā puruṣarṣabhau ।śayānau puṇḍarīkākṣau kumārāviva pāvakī ।। 6.47.20 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter Sita beheld both Rama and Lakshmana lying on the bed of arrows, unconscious, struck by arrows, with shields of darts, arrows with feathers, all limbs wounded with shattered armour, bows and reeds.
translations.hindi: फिर वेगब।न हनुमान जी के दस बाण मार, अमित तेजस्वी गबादे और शरभ के महावेः वान मेघनाद ने दो दो बाण मारे गोलाङ.गूलो' के अध्यक्षा अर्थात्‌ गवाक्ष तथा बालिपुत्र चङ्गद के . उस फुर्तीले मेघनाद ने बहुत से बाण मारे। उन वारनश्रेष्ठों को अग्नि शिखा सदुश दमकते हुए बाणों से घायल कर

verses.sloka: शरतल्पगतौ वीरौ तथाभूतौ नरर्षभौ ।दुःखार्ता सुभृशं सीता सुचिरं विललाप ह ।। ६.४७.२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śaratalpagatau vīrau tathābhūtau nararṣabhau ।duḥkhārtā subhṛśaṁ sītā suciraṁ vilalāpa ha ।। 6.47.21 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing the gallant bulls among men, the two brothers with big eyes, the two heroes like sons of fire god lying on the bed of arrows in such a state, Sita was filled with intense sorrow and pity burst into tears being affected extremely.

verses.sloka: भर्तारमनवद्याङ्गी लक्ष्मणं चासितेक्षणा ।प्रेक्ष्य पांसुषु वेष्टन्तौ रुरोद जनकात्मजा ।। ६.४७.२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhartāramanavadyāṅgī lakṣmaṇaṁ cāsitekṣaṇā ।prekṣya pāṁsuṣu veṣṭantau ruroda janakātmajā ।। 6.47.22 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing the gallant bulls among men, the two brothers with big eyes, the two heroes like sons of fire god lying on the bed of arrows in such a state, Sita was filled with intense sorrow and pity burst into tears being affected extremely.

verses.sloka: सा बाष्पशोकाभिहता समीक्ष्य तौ भ्रातरौ देवसमप्रभावौ ।वितर्कयन्ती निधनं तयोः सा दुःखान्विता वाक्यमिदं जगाद ।। ६.४७.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sā bāṣpaśokābhihatā samīkṣya tau bhrātarau devasamaprabhāvau ।vitarkayantī nidhanaṁ tayoḥ sā duḥkhānvitā vākyamidaṁ jagāda ।। 6.47.23 ।।

translations.english: Janaka's daughter of beautiful limbs and dark eyes, seeing her husband and Lakshmana, both powerful ones rolling, roared aloud.
